critical_code_review_comments: Note: Score changes are only visible when PPA is below benchmark (55.0). When PPA is already above benchmark, the score is maxed out for that metric and further increases won't change the total_score. This is expected behavior based on the scoring formula with capped scores and max bonuses.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug fixes verified for employee metric editing. The scoring formula caps individual metric scores at 100 and bonuses at 5.0 per metric. When testing score changes, use employees with PPA below 55.0 (the benchmark) to see visible score changes. Employees with PPA already above benchmark won't show score changes because they're already at max for that metric.

scoring_formula_notes.score_calculation: score = (value / benchmark) * 100, capped at 100 for weighted calculation
